column1: # Provisions of the counted local voucher rules, other than the payment that is counted, that give home-made computing (chips, servers, computing facilities, computing power, or software adapted to home-made chips) something that other computing does not get: one row per provision. Made on Nov 25, 2026. Two independent readings of the 90 rules counted then, each listing every provision on home-made computing, were taken as leads (the 91st, Shantou's implementing rules, counted later the same day, was read whole on its saved copy: 国产, 信创 and 安全可控 stand there 0 times and 自主 only in 自主申报 and 自主编制, applying and drafting on one's own: no row); each provision was then read on the rule's saved copy and ruled, every rule's copy was also searched for 国产, 自主, 信创 and 安全可控, and every Chinese string in the words column is found in that copy by script, with planted strings that are not found.

# Kinds. BUILD: money for building, buying or running computing facilities or equipment only where they are home-made (Fuzhou's is an operating subsidy to such facilities, by the computing they sell or use). ADAPT: an award or subsidy for adapting models or software to home-made chips or computing, or for research built on them (Hebei district of Tianjin). USE2: a higher rate, cap or quota for using home-made computing in a provision other than the counted payment (none found). PREFER: a priority, a preference in purchasing, a required share or a condition, in words that bind (Beijing city's condition on its suppliers).

# The cautious reading: a provision is listed only where the copy's own words carry it. Not listed: aims, encouragement and advocacy with no money and no binding words (鼓励, 倡导, 引导, 推广, 加强); awards for a firm's own (自主) models, software, data sets or intellectual property; research on chips themselves; tasks with no money; and items paid inside the counted payment at its one rate (the adaptation services that Binhaiwan New Area's and Hunan's payments name). The class of a rule does not change by these rows: it is decided by the counted payment alone (tables/local_vouchers_classes.tsv, whose row ids, governments and classes this table repeats).

# Columns: row_id | government | class | kind | article (the provision's number or heading in the copy) | words (the copy's own words; parts separated by " / ") | what_it_gives (in English) | saved_id
